name: Tuam Banda
bio: The council knows a Tuam Banda who argues against peace. A report from the bridge names a captain similarly; the messenger cannot vouch that both accounts name the same man.
notes: fact: Pires names Tuam Banda among opponents of peace; Birch reports the bridge defense and death of a captain named Tuão Bandao (Pires II, p. 280; Birch III, pp. 105–106)
inference: The names may identify one person, but the sources do not establish this (people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: Treat the link as an attributed report rather than a fixed identity or death (people-factions.md §2)
